character_table.brief.md:
Defines mappings between UTF-8 codepoint sequences (characters) and their visual representations (pixmaps).

## Use Cases

- **Character-to-glyph mapping** - Associates text characters, including single utf8 codepoints, ligatures, and grapheme clusters, with their pixmap representation.

brief.constant_codepoint_count.md: The exact codepoint length of each `codepoints` field in this table

flag.use_constant_codepoint_count.md: All characters in this table have the same number of codepoints.

brief.pixmap_tables.md: Vector of Pixmap Table indices this character table references.

flag.link_pixmap_tables.md: This table links to one or more Pixmap Tables.

brief.use_advance_x.md: Each record includes an `advance_x` field specifying horizontal pixel advance after rendering.
brief.use_pixmap_index.md: Each record includes a `pixmap_index` field to explicitly reference a pixmap by index.
brief.use_pixmap_table_index.md: Each record includes a `pixmap_table_index` field to specify which linked Pixmap Table to reference.

details.use_advance_x.md: When disabled, the default advance is the pixmap's width. Letter spacing, if any, is added to the advance value.
details.use_pixmap_index.md: When disabled, the pixmap index defaults to match the character record index (1:1 mapping).
details.use_pixmap_table_index.md: When disabled, the renderer searches linked Pixmap Tables in order until finding a valid pixmap at the character's index. The first pixmap linked will have priority over the last.

brief.advance_x.md: Number of pixels to advance horizontally after rendering this character.

condition.codepoints.md: UTF-8 encoded codepoint sequence (null-terminated unless `constant_codepoint_count` is set).
condition.pixmap_index.md: Index of the pixmap within the referenced Pixmap Table(s).
condition.pixmap_table_index.md: Index of the specific Pixmap Table to use for this character.
